spiritgiven.comments: Some physical contact that could be avoid, but in general great game.
A lot of contact and physical game in the second half - M
With the game intensity the physical contact increase we can avoid that and keep the good attitude and self - control

spiritreceived.comments: You are so much fun and set a great example of attitude which we aspire to follow throughout the tournament. Our energy rose because of your positivity and enthusiasm. We really appreciated the fair mindedness where teammates encouraged each other to retract calls they felt were wrong, in addition to the open mindedness to hear these conflicting perspectives. Grasias Colombia
Thank you for always giving me positive words.

Gracias for the wonderfully positive game! We were really impressed that you remembered all our names and always smiling, cheering both teams throughout this very intense game! Nothing new to add, only the two points we mentioned in the circle about travels (changing direction, changing the pivot and accelerating after the two steps to stop), and fast count. We enjoyed the game, the passion you put in and look forward to meeting you again! Maybe for a dance off too!

Travel and fast counts were used again. There were couple of dangerous plays that did not result in any major injuries but could have been. Otherwise their attitude was great and it was fun on the sidelines.

Great energy Colombia! Thank you for all your support during the game! We only have one thing to highlight about the fair mindedness: you are always open to dialogue but not very open to reflecting on the calls made. We encourage you to consider whether a call affects the outcome of the play.
Great spirit and consistent high-fiving and learning of names. We really appreciate the continual effort on and off the field. We were looking forward to this! Thank you so much for a great game.
Exemplary! Watch the game and you'll see what we mean! Muchas gracias, Co-co-colombia!

We appreciate your fair-mindedness. We admire your willingness to accept the opinions of others. If there was one thing that could be improved, we thought that if we had a better understanding of the travel rules, we might be able to play a more enjoyable game.
